candidates.description: These tokens represent possessive determiners and pronouns across multiple languages.

This vector represents floral and avian elements commonly associated with nature, gardens, and springtime.
This vector activates strongly for personal pronouns across multiple European languages.
This vector represents religious and cultural terms, particularly those associated with Islam and Middle Eastern geography, alongside some European religious and linguistic elements.

This vector represents affectionate, romantic, and positive emotional concepts and related vocabulary.

This vector represents common German auxiliary and modal verbs in various conjugated forms.
